# secobserve_product_member (Resource)

Grants a user a role on a product or a product group. The same endpoint serves both, so pass a product group's id in `product` to grant a role there.

~> Whoever creates a product becomes an `Owner` member of it automatically. Declaring a membership for the identity the provider authenticates as therefore fails as a duplicate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_user" "alice" {
  username = "alice"
}

resource "secobserve_product_member" "alice" {
  product = secobserve_product.checkout.id
  user    = data.secobserve_user.alice.id
  role    = "Maintainer"
}

# Note that whoever creates a product is already an Owner member of it. Since
# Terraform creates products as the provider's own identity, declaring a
# membership for that same user fails as a duplicate.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (Number) Id of the product or product group. Immutable: SecObserve rejects moving a membership, so a change replaces it.
- `role` (String) Role granted to the user, in ascending order of privilege: `Reader`, `Upload`, `Writer`, `Maintainer`, `Owner`.

~> Granting or changing `Owner` requires the provider's own identity to be an owner of the product or a superuser.
- `user` (Number) Id of the user. Use the `secobserve_user` data source to resolve a username. Immutable: a change replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the membership.
